$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006): the evaluation request of Floorspec Rules 0.1. A request it rejects, or one that is not well-formed JSON, is FS-RULES-001 (1.1.1).
title: Floorspec Rules 0.1 evaluation request
description: 1.1: the packs, the profile and the units. Each pack and the profile are checked by their own schemas (2.1, 10.1), not by this one.

packs.title: Packs
packs.description: 1.1: the packs to evaluate; each is checked by the pack schema (FS-RULES-004).

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: 1.1: the profile; absent, the default profile (10.6). It is checked by the profile schema (FS-RULES-002).
